what: a join of two pleated skins (lofts between 24-pleat star outlines, less the same loft moved in 1.1 mm) that cross along a ring near their bottoms: truck panicked ('tolerance must be no less than 1e-6') or gave no result
method: the reporter's own script (pleated_union.py, 24 pleats). Every outline has its 48 vertices on the rays k 7.5 deg, so each ruled loft's section at height z is the star polygon with the radii interpolated linearly along those rays (its faces are bilinear between straight edges), of area 1/2 sin7.5 sum r_k r_k+1, quadratic in z (Simpson exact). Each skin is its loft less the inner loft, which lies inside it on every ray over the skin's height and runs a mm past both ends: cone skin 39321.316290, lip skin 5571.952291. They cross between z = -0.88 and 0.28; their common part, per wedge between two rays the region between the larger inner and the smaller outer straight edge (cut where edges cross, exact triangles), integrated over z by Gauss: 449.775981. V = cone + lip - common. Faces: the four sets of 48 sides each cut in two by the crossing, + the four end annuli (the two bottoms at z = -1 apart: r 114.69..115.79 and 113.35..114.44). Bbox: the lip's top outline reaches r 120 on the axes, the cone runs z -1..88.3
